title: Shifting VeinMiner
description: This mod adds a veinminer similar to tree feller mods that brings the ores to you as you mine them, preserving the vanilla feel of the game
body:
# ⛏️ Shifting Vein Miner

Tired of awkward ore veins forcing you to dig in every direction? **Shifting Vein Miner** brings the satisfying convenience of *FallingTree* by Rakembda 🌲⛏️ into the underground! Instead of chopping down a tree from one spot, this mod lets you mine ore veins more smoothly by **shifting connected ores toward the block where you started mining**.

As you mine, nearby connected ore blocks move into the original position, creating the feeling of the vein collapsing inward and allowing you to continue mining from a single location 🪨✨. It keeps mining efficient and satisfying without instantly deleting the whole vein, preserving the feel of actually working through the ore.

Whether you're deep in the caves hunting diamonds 💎, clearing massive iron deposits ⛓️, or gathering coal for your next expedition 🔥, **Shifting Vein Miner** helps keep the flow going while staying true to the vanilla experience.

---

## 🛠️ How To Use

1. ⛏️ Find an ore vein  
2. 🧎 **Crouch (Shift)** while mining an ore block  
3. 🔄 Connected ores will begin **shifting toward the block you started mining**

> 💡 **Tip:** Only crouch-mine when you want the effect to activate, making it easy to swap between normal mining and shifting mode whenever you want!
